header.description: Real solid harmonics R_n^m, I_n^m and their Cartesian gradients (docs/CONVENTIONS.md §3.3, §3.6) at seeded random points
header.layout: real storage, index n*n + n + m for -n <= m <= n (§3.6)
header.format: decimal strings, 17 significant digits of the nearest double; grad is [d/dx, d/dy, d/dz], each in the same layout as value
